quote_original: In 25 years, Modi par ek paise ke ghotale ka aarop nhi laga.
quote_english: I have been serving the country as CM and PM for nearly 25 years. In 25 years, there has been no corruption allegation against Modi.
summary: Corruption allegations were levelled against the Modi government during this period (for example over the Rafale deal and electoral bonds), while no court conviction was recorded against the Prime Minister.

analysis:
At an election rally in Palamu, Jharkhand on 4 May 2024, Modi said that in nearly 25 years as Chief Minister and Prime Minister no corruption allegation had been levelled against him.

Corruption allegations were in fact made against him and his government during this period, including the Congress's Rafale-related allegations in 2018-19 and the electoral-bonds funding controversy. The Supreme Court struck down the electoral bonds scheme as unconstitutional in February 2024.

No court conviction for corruption was recorded against Modi, and the intended reading may be that no charge has been proved. The literal claim that no allegation was ever levelled is not supported, so the statement is assessed as misleading.
notes: Hindi quote is as reported by The Kashmir Horizon. The verdict distinguishes allegations (which were made) from proof/conviction (which is absent); reasonable readers may differ on how strictly to read the claim.
